Evaluate Independent Token-Count Screens Without Modifying Metric Values

lexdiv_screen_lengths.Rd

Describes which rows in a plan-based lexical-diversity result meet declared token-count floors without removing or altering any metric calculation.

Usage

lexdiv_screen_lengths(
  x,
  floors = c(tokens_50 = 50L, tokens_100 = 100L),
  max_rows = 2e+06
)

Arguments

x

A plan-based result returned by lexdiv_metrics, lexdiv_metrics_batch, lexdiv_metrics_text, or lexdiv_metrics_text_batch.

floors

A non-empty named numeric vector of positive integer token-count screens. Names become screen_id; values become minimum_tokens.

max_rows

A positive integer bound on source-row-by-floor output rows, checked before allocation.

Value

A lexdiv_screen_results data frame with one row per source result and named floor, containing screen_id, minimum_tokens, N, and passes_screen. It deliberately omits metric values so screening remains independent of score inspection.

See also

lexdiv_plan, lexdiv_length_evidence

Examples

plan <- lexdiv_plan(presets = character(), specs = list(
  lexdiv_spec("ttr", request_id = "ttr")
))
res <- lexdiv_metrics_text_batch(
  c(short = "a b c", longer = paste(rep("word", 60), collapse = " ")),
  plan = plan
)
screens <- lexdiv_screen_lengths(res)
screens[, c("document_id", "screen_id", "N", "minimum_tokens", "passes_screen")]
#>   document_id  screen_id  N minimum_tokens passes_screen
#> 1       short  tokens_50  3             50         FALSE
#> 2       short tokens_100  3            100         FALSE
#> 3      longer  tokens_50 60             50          TRUE
#> 4      longer tokens_100 60            100         FALSE
